title: TACITUS incremental corpus evaluation protocol
status: PROPOSED; no corpus-scale component benchmark executed for this addendum
relation_to_original_blueprint: Additive protocol and 24 adversarial scenarios; original 35 proposed cases remain proposed.

corpus.nesting: Frozen core plus realistic additional distractors; report byte/page/chunk/language distributions
corpus.privacy: Use public or separately authorized source snapshots; no private corpus was used for research.

tasks.independence: Second-review high-consequence/disputed judgments; do not use tested extractor alone as gold.

conditions.name: existing_literal_entity_capsule_selection
conditions.scope_caution: bounded prebuilt capsules; report matched-scope comparison

fixed_controls: generation model/prompt if generation separately authorized

contract_release_gates.caution: Passing observed cases is not a guarantee against unseen failures.

analysis: Paired per-task comparisons; uncertainty intervals clustered by dossier; do not treat nested corpus sizes as independent samples; publish fallbacks/failures/abstentions.
acceptance_thresholds: Predeclare minimum useful relevance/saliency improvement and tolerable operational regression after baseline measurement; no fabricated thresholds or superiority claim.

cases.setup: Rare exact identifier with an empty dense candidate set
cases.expected: Independent lexical retrieval returns the eligible evidence; record current baseline failure separately.

cases.setup: Repeat C01 after withdrawal while retaining stale index entries
cases.expected: Compiler rejects withdrawn evidence and records why.

cases.setup: Reimport the same source occurrence and identical bytes
cases.expected: No duplicate source revision or accepted assertion; replay is safe.

cases.setup: Two separately attributed sources contain identical bytes
cases.expected: Computation may be shared; source attribution, rights and policy remain distinct.

cases.setup: Whitespace-only source change matches normalized extraction cache
cases.expected: New exact source revision and span mapping are checked; old acceptance is not inherited.

cases.setup: Changed content retains the same positional chunk ID
cases.expected: Stale extraction is not accepted by positional identity.

cases.setup: Parser, prompt, model, chunker or schema configuration changes
cases.expected: Cache compatibility is explicit; acceptance cannot transfer silently.

cases.setup: A quotation occurs twice or crosses overlapping chunks
cases.expected: Adapter identifies the intended occurrence or marks mapping unresolved.

cases.setup: OCR or normalization changes a character or negation
cases.expected: Exact extraction-artifact citation and derived-source warning remain visible; no raw-original-byte claim.

cases.setup: Two people share the same normalized name
cases.expected: No automatic canonical merge without additional evidence.

cases.setup: One person has reviewed multilingual aliases
cases.expected: Aliases can retrieve the same reviewed identity without changing source-language text.

cases.setup: A mistaken merge is later split
cases.expected: Dependent claims/capsules are traceable and invalidated or rebuilt; prior history is retained.

cases.setup: A post changes occupant on a sourced date
cases.expected: Post identity persists and role occupancy is interval-scoped.

cases.setup: A historical source is ingested after a newer source
cases.expected: Known-at time and world-valid time are distinct; ingestion does not establish legal effect.

cases.setup: Two attributed sources disagree without explicit correction
cases.expected: Disagreement is retained rather than resolved by recency.

cases.setup: A valid explicit correction arrives
cases.expected: Dependency closure includes correction; stale derivative status is visible.

cases.setup: Index update fails after catalog write or vice versa
cases.expected: No silently mixed generation is served; recovery is idempotent.

cases.setup: Read immediately after committed lexical update
cases.expected: Reader refresh/generation contract determines visibility reproducibly.

cases.setup: Many duplicated press releases compete with one mandatory exception
cases.expected: Duplication does not suppress the necessary qualification.

cases.setup: User-priority metadata is enabled versus disabled
cases.expected: Fixed-budget weighted coverage is compared separately from relevance and truth.

cases.setup: Held-out cross-language question shares no tokens with supporting evidence
cases.expected: Semantic retrieval success or failure is measured honestly; literal fallback is not called cross-language understanding.

cases.setup: Required evidence closure exceeds capsule or context bounds
cases.expected: Refusal/omission is explicit; essential caveats are not silently dropped.

cases.setup: Ineligible source has very high retrieval score
cases.expected: Access and eligibility filters prevent disclosure, including stale candidate paths.

cases.setup: Proposal body changes while its external ID/review label remains unchanged
cases.expected: Payload-bound acceptance fails; imported review authority is not trusted.
